_source: backend/scripts/calibrate_reference_coverage.py over the serving members' stored inputs, seeds 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, each with 500 random subsets per share and 200 resamples per member for the noise; each floor is the strictest the seeds gave (floors_by_seed), so rerunning with the same seeds and draws on the same data reproduces it. Per chamber and reference: the smallest share of the chamber whose reference, measured on a random subset (90th percentile of the draws) or the roster's first members in Congress.gov's order, moves neither the 95th-percentile member's overall score by more than that member's own noise (bills resampled, party-line breaks redrawn, display rounding) nor a party's mean score by more than its standard error. Each curve runs from 100% down to the first share past that bar, where the floor is decided. Below it a run carries the last reference measured on full coverage (live_references). Regenerate after a scoring change.
